documents.content:
COST SUMMARY
Labor (field crew, 6 workers × 9 days): $14,850.00
Materials – Poured Rubber Surface System (2-layer, 3/4" wear course + 3" base): $31,200.00
Materials – Geotextile fabric, drainage aggregate, edge restraints: $4,175.00
Materials – Concrete (curb repair, 12 linear ft): $860.00
Equipment rental (mini excavator, plate compactor, mixer): $2,400.00
Permit and inspection fees: $350.00
Mobilization/demobilization: $1,250.00
Contingency (approx. 5%): $2,754.00
TOTAL ESTIMATED COST: $57,839.00
FINAL BILLING TOTAL: $58,106.50 (includes change order #1, see below)

CHANGE ORDER #1 (approved 05/12/2023)
Description: Added 220 sq ft of rubber surface at the south exit path to eliminate a
tripping hazard caused by exposed tree root. Additional material and labor: $267.50.
Approved by: J. Whitaker, FAO Deputy Director

WORK DESCRIPTION / TASK LOG

03/15/2023 – WO opened. Initial site visit completed by FAO inspector T. Nguyen.
Noted existing surface (pea gravel) does not meet current accessibility standards for
playground surfaces. Photos taken: IMG_20230315_01 through IMG_20230315_14 (see photo
log attached to file).

03/20/2023 – Contractor mobilization. Staging area designated in the west parking lot.
Fencing installed around work zone. Playground closed to students and staff until further
notice. Principal notified via email 03/20/2023.

03/21/2023 – Removal of existing pea gravel began. Crew encountered compacted clay
layer at 4-6" depth. Additional excavation required to achieve proper base depth (8").
This was within original scope allowance.

03/23/2023 – Removal of wood fiber chips in the swing area completed. Chips stockpiled
near the maintenance shed for reuse in non-accessible landscape beds (per Principal
request). No cost change.

03/24/2023 – Subgrade prep started. Geotextile fabric installed over compacted base.
Drainage aggregate placed and compacted in 2 lifts. Inspector T. Nguyen visited site at
2:30 PM, noted proper compaction (see field notes, 03/24).

03/27/2023 – Edge restraints (aluminum) installed along the north and west boundaries.
Concrete curb repair at north edge completed by subcontractor (Concrete Works LLC).
Curing time 48 hours.

03/29/2023 – Change order #1 requested by contractor due to exposed root at south exit
path. FAO approved 05/12/2023 (see above). Work on this item scheduled for late May.

Riverside Elementary School work order specifies has_accessible_playground_surface_type as poured rubber. Record status: current.

04/03/2023 – Rain delay. No work performed 04/03 through 04/05. Site remained secure.
Water pooled in low area near the east corner; contractor added a temporary drainage
swale at no extra cost.

04/10/2023 – Base layer of poured rubber installed on the main playground area.
Weather conditions: clear, 62°F. Crew of 6 worked 7:00 AM – 4:30 PM. Base layer
thickness verified at 3" using depth gauge (see inspection form, 04/10).

04/11/2023 – Wear course (top layer, 3/4" thickness) installed over base layer.
Color: "Forest Green" (MPS color code FG-204). Surface allowed to cure for 72 hours
before foot traffic. Signage posted.

04/14/2023 – Contractor began work on accessible route from the primary walkway to
the transfer platform. Route width confirmed at 60". Slope measured at 1:20 (max
allowed 1:12). Surface is poured rubber, continuous, no gaps.

04/17/2023 – Parking space markings repainted. Two spaces designated as accessible
with the International Symbol of Accessibility. Signage installed at the head of each
space (post-mounted, 5' height to bottom of sign). Note: one sign was damaged during
installation; replacement sign ordered and installed 04/20/2023.

04/24/2023 – Final surface inspection by FAO inspector T. Nguyen. Found two minor
surface bubbles (approx. 1" diameter each) near the southeast corner. Contractor
patched these on 04/25/2023 using same material. No other deficiencies noted.

05/12/2023 – Change order #1 approved (see above). Work on south exit path scheduled
for week of 05/22/2023.

05/24/2023 – South exit path resurfaced (additional 220 sq ft). Work completed in one
day. Area reopened 05/25/2023.

06/01/2023 – Interim inspection by FAO inspector M. Chen (covering for T. Nguyen).
Noted that the playground surface is fully accessible and meets the project spec.
Photo log updated: IMG_20230601_01 through IMG_20230601_09.

documents.title: Work Order for Riverside Elementary Playground Renovation
documents.content:
Scope (as approved 03/06/2023):
1. Remove existing asphalt playground surface and install poured rubber (base 3", wear course 3/4") in main playground area (approx. 4,800 sq ft).
2. Install accessible route from primary walkway to transfer platform, min. width 48".
3. Repaint and re-sign accessible parking spaces (2 spaces) near main entrance.
4. Resurface south exit path (added via CO #1).
5. Site safety perimeter fencing and dust control during removal.

PROGRESS LOG (continued)

06/08/2023 — Work on south exit path complete. Final grading checked by contractor foreman. No punch list items at this time. Area open for use. Photo log: IMG_20230608_01 through IMG_20230608_04.

06/12/2023 — FAO inspector T. Nguyen performed mid-project review (not final). Verified route width from primary walkway to transfer platform. Measurement taken at three points: 48", 48", 48". Route width confirmed at 48 inches per spec. Slope 1:20. Surface continuous, no lips or gaps. Record status: current. See inspection form dated 06/12/2023.

06/14/2023 — Contractor submitted invoice #118-0421 for base layer and wear course installation. Payment pending final inspection. Invoice amount $31,750.

06/15/2023 — Parking area lines re-striped (non-accessible spaces) to match new accessible stall layout. No conflicts with existing striping.

06/20/2023 — School summer maintenance crew requested access to playground for routine mowing. Contractor confirmed surface fully cured and safe for light maintenance equipment. Access granted.

06/22/2023 — Minor settlement noted near the southwest corner of the playground, approx. 1/4" depression. Contractor notified. Crew to inspect on 06/26/2023.

06/26/2023 — Contractor inspected the southwest corner. Determined depression was due to soil compaction under the base layer, not a defect in the rubber surface. Filled with additional base material and re-applied wear course patch (approx. 2 sq ft). Cured overnight. Reopened 06/27/2023. No further issues noted.

07/03/2023 — Change order #1 final paperwork received by FAO. Signed by contractor and FAO project manager. Copy placed in contract file.

Riverside Elementary School work order states has_accessible_route_width of 48 inches. Record status: current.

07/10/2023 — Pre-final walkthrough with principal (K. Alvarez) and building custodian (J. Ortiz). Principal requested additional signage at the playground entrance noting the accessible route. FAO approved; sign ordered.

07/14/2023 — Signage installed at playground entrance: "Accessible Route — 48 inch clear width" (MPS sign code AR-48). Post-mounted, 5' to bottom of sign. Photo log: IMG_20230714_01.

07/18/2023 — Contractor completed final cleanup of work area. Removed excess material, swept walkways, and hauled away debris. Site left clean.

07/24/2023 — Final inspection requested by contractor. Scheduled for 07/28/2023.

07/28/2023 — FINAL INSPECTION — FAO inspector T. Nguyen. Result: PASS. All items from original scope and change order #1 verified. Route width measured at 48 inches (three locations). Surface thickness verified at 3" base / 3/4" wear course. No deficiencies found. Inspector noted one minor cosmetic color variation near the east edge (approx. 6"x6") but this does not affect accessibility or safety. Acceptable. Final inspection form signed and filed.

08/02/2023 — Punch list: none. Work order marked COMPLETED.

08/03/2023 — Final invoice #118-0427 submitted by contractor. Amount $52,150. Payment approved 08/07/2023.

08/08/2023 — Work order closed. Final documentation sent to school office and contract file. Warranty period begins (5-year surface warranty, 1-year labor).

NOTES / MISC
- All work performed during school hours when playground was not in use. No injuries reported.
- Contractor provided daily site safety logs (available on request).
- Temporary fencing removed 06/01/2023 after surface cured.
- Water pooling issue (04/03) resolved with temporary drainage swale; no recurrence noted through 08/08/2023.
- Custodian J. Ortiz has key to the playground gate; contractor key returned 08/05/2023.
